# Overview

We here use data from healthy antrum Infinium EPIC arrays to classify CpG sites into three classes - biallelically methylated (mm), biallelically unmethylated (uu) and hemimethylated (um) sites. 

```{r, message=FALSE}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach.RData") )

#ed$SampleLabel <- ifelse(ed$Project=="ZZU", paste0(ed$Sample_Group, "_", ed$PatientID, "_", ed$CloneID), ed$Sample_Name )

ed$Sample_Group2 <- ifelse(ed$Project == "ZZU", paste0("Polyclonal-",ed$Sample_Group), paste0("Healthy-", ed$Stomach_site)) 
ed$Sample_Group2 <- factor(ed$Sample_Group2, levels=c("Healthy-Antrum","Healthy-Corpus","Healthy-Fundus","Polyclonal-NON_IM","Polyclonal-IM"))
```

```{r}
mm = myNorm[, subset(ed, Sample_Group2 == "Healthy-Antrum")$Sample_ID]

row_means <- rowMeans(mm)

hist(row_means, 100, main = "Mean beta in n=6 healthy antrum samples")
abline(v=c(0.25, 0.75), lty=2, lwd=1, col="red")

cpg_class_u.m <- data.frame(row.names = names(row_means), mean_beta = row_means)
cpg_class_u.m$u.m_class <- ifelse(cpg_class_u.m$mean_beta < 0.25, "uu", ifelse(cpg_class_u.m$mean_beta>0.75, "mm", "um"))
```

```{r}
table(cpg_class_u.m$u.m_class)
table(cpg_class_u.m$u.m_class) |> prop.table()
```

# WGS methylation classes

See Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/Antrum_methylation_class_WGS.Rmd for details. 
[0=uu, 1=um, 2=mm]

```{r}
cpg_class_wgs <- readRDS(file.path("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/", "WGS_Cpg_Meth_classes_EPIC.rds"))
```

```{r}
table(cpg_class_wgs[, "Gastric.antrum"])
```


```{r}
tmp <- merge(cpg_class_u.m, cpg_class_wgs, by.x=0, by.y=0)

m <- table(tmp$u.m_class, ifelse(tmp$Gastric.antrum==0, "uu", ifelse(tmp$Gastric.antrum==1, "um","mm")), dnn=c("EPIC","WGS"))
m
prop.table(m) |> round(digits = 3)
prop.table(m) |> pheatmap::pheatmap()

table(tmp$u.m_class == ifelse(tmp$Gastric.antrum==0, "uu", ifelse(tmp$Gastric.antrum==1, "um","mm")), dnn="Concordance") |> prop.table()

```

```{r}
comp = "IM_antrum_vs_healthy_antrum"
```

```{r}
dm_im <- rbind(all_hyper_cpg[[comp]], all_hypo_cpg[[comp]])
dm_im$direction_im <- ifelse(dm_im$logFC > 0, "hyper","hypo")
dm_im$dge_class <- with(dm_im, ifelse(logFC > 0, ifelse(logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(logFC< -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))

im_vs_healthy_results <- merge(cpg_class_u.m, dm_im, by.x=0, by.y="Row.names", all.x=T, sort=F)
im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class <- ifelse(is.na(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class), "ns/nc", im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class)
im_vs_healthy_results$direction_im <- ifelse(is.na(im_vs_healthy_results$direction_im), "ns/nc", im_vs_healthy_results$direction_im)
```


```{r}
table(im_vs_healthy_results$u.m_class)
table(im_vs_healthy_results$u.m_class) |> prop.table()
table(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class, im_vs_healthy_results$u.m_class, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum"))
table(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class, im_vs_healthy_results$u.m_class, dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum")) |> prop.table(margin=1)
```

# IM antrum  vs. healthy antrum, only EPIC samples

## WGS antrum methylation calls

```{r}
comp = "IM_antrum_vs_healthy_antrum"
```

```{r}
dm_im <- rbind(all_hyper_cpg[[comp]], all_hypo_cpg[[comp]])
dm_im$direction_im <- ifelse(dm_im$logFC > 0, "hyper","hypo")
dm_im$dge_class <- with(dm_im, ifelse(logFC > 0, ifelse(logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hyper_weak"), ifelse(logFC< -0.2, "hypo", "hypo_weak")))

im_vs_healthy_results <- merge(cpg_class_wgs, dm_im, by.x=0, by.y="Row.names", all.x=T, sort=F)
im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class <- ifelse(is.na(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class), "ns/nc", im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class)
im_vs_healthy_results$direction_im <- ifelse(is.na(im_vs_healthy_results$direction_im), "ns/nc", im_vs_healthy_results$direction_im)
```



```{r}
m <- table(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class, ifelse(im_vs_healthy_results$Gastric.antrum==0, "uu", ifelse(im_vs_healthy_results$Gastric.antrum==1, "um","mm")), dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy antrum [WGS]") ) 
m
m |> prop.table(margin=1)
```


## WGS colon methylation calls


```{r}
m <- table(im_vs_healthy_results$dge_class, ifelse(im_vs_healthy_results$Colon.Right==0, "uu", ifelse(im_vs_healthy_results$Gastric.antrum==1, "um","mm")), dnn=c("DGE class","Meth. state in healthy right colon [WGS]") ) 
m
m |> prop.table(margin=1)
```
